2.text: Your eye is the lamp of your body.

3.text: If your eye sees clearly, your whole body benefits from the light.

4.text: If your eyesight is poor, your whole person is without light.

7.text: Lately, I've been following A.I. trends on my Instagram.

8.text: I think I have more A.I. feeds, than updates from my friends.

9.text: As a result, it's what I constantly think of... even in idle times.

10.text: I keep telling myself, okay, at least it's work related.

11.text: But I know... I am consumed by it.

13.text: On my recent birthday trip to the Japan Alps,

14.text: I purposely uninstalled my social media, and A.I. apps.

15.text: I focused on the nature in front of me.

16.text: It felt like living a life close to nature.

18.text: In today's gospel, I am reminded to bring Jesus' light, into my whole being.

20.text: Will I think the way He thinks?

21.text: Will I grow more in His mercy and compassion?

22.text: Lately, I was too busy... to pray.

23.text: I don’t even have a journal entry for the month of September.

24.text: I want to go back to writing... and seeing God more.

25.text: To be able to go back to His holy presence, every day, is enough.

26.text: I hope to be able to, again, tomorrow.
